flows:
Navigate to https://openlibrary.org/?lang=ar then On this first page, verify that the site's own interface (menus, buttons, headings and labels; not book titles or covers) is shown in Arabic and contains no raw translation keys such as section.some_label.
Verify that the page layout direction suits Arabic: for a right-to-left language such as Arabic, Hebrew or Persian, the page must be laid out right-to-left, with interface text aligned to the right and navigation and rows starting from the right side; for a left-to-right language it must be laid out left-to-right.
Search for the book Dune and open the first book in the results. Verify the same two things on that book page.
If any verification fails, fail the test at that step.
